title: Measure record (MOP or MOE)
description: One measure, one Markdown file per record (measures/MOE-001.md), with the seven doctrine fields: id, objective, definition, source, value+time (its readings: value events in the sidecar, never written in the record), target, confidence+thinness. A MOP (measure of performance) asks whether the work is being done, a MOE (measure of effectiveness) whether it is working. source is a typed binding: invariant:<id>, status:<source>[/<item>], records:<lane>[?type=<type>], manual or none (not measurable: a finding, written in the Not measurable section). 2.0 (ADR-0019): a record is identified by its `uid` (a UUIDv7) and names its `type`; every link is a uid; the numbered `id` is gone (the number a record is shown with is computed from type, parent and sibling `order`, never stored). The record-type rules of a link (which types a parent, supports, serves or raised_by may name) are the doctrine's `hierarchy` and `links`, checked by homelabnext.strategy. 1.x records are read only by `hnx records assign-uids`, which migrates them.

parent.description: The uid of the objective it measures (SO, OO, TO or TT, per the doctrine's hierarchy).

order.description: Optional: the sort key among its siblings (same type, same parent). Siblings without one follow, in creation (uid) order.

kind.description: activity: a count of work done (never a MOE); output: a property of what the work produced; outcome: an effect on the lab.

target.description: green when value op green; else amber when value op amber; else red.

confidence.description: The author's confidence in the method; a thin reading is reported low.

thinness.description: A reading is thin when fewer data points than min_sample stand behind it, or it is older than max_age_h.

definition_version.description: Bumped whenever definition, source or unit changes (a redefinition is never silent).

values.description: Derived from the value events; never written in the record file.

reviews.description: Derived from the review events (homelabnext.reviews); never written in the record file.

uid.description: A record uid: a canonical UUIDv7 (lowercase, version 7), created with the record and never changed (ADR-0019).
